control_failures.control_label: secondary containment by bund and drainage

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: prohibition notice - work stopped during a statutory inspection on V-4110

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the secondary containment by bund and drainage on V-4110 and PSV-4110 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in managing hydrocarbon transfer and storage, specifically bunding, drainage and spill containment. V-4110 (hydrocarbon day tanks and surge vessel) is in service for diesel and light hydrocarbon day storage, discharge surge suppression. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 11 February 2022 a regulatory notice was issued concerning V-4110 and PSV-4110 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility following a statutory inspection.
